subject: planner, executor: allow build root task type of expand operator and implement expand executor (#54536)
summary: Implements TiDB-side Expand execution (new `ExpandExec`) and wires it into the executor builder; updates planner physical plan enumeration and task attachment so `PhysicalExpand` can be built/attached in root tasks (in addition to existing MPP/TiFlash usage), enabling `WITH ROLLUP` expand execution on TiDB.
